steps.what: Send the environmental material certificate
Read environmental values into a row

loop.input: certificate text and the limit names
loop.output: one row per limit name found on the certificate
loop.check: Each value cites a line on the certificate
loop.stop: Leave the value blank and stop that limit if no line matches
loop.why_not_simpler: Certificate layout varies and a fixed column map misses scans

steps.what: Witness materials against the standards
Compare values with the environmental limits
Sign the environmental materials decision

tasks.design: The supplier sends a certificate. A bounded read pulls material id, standard id and values into a {SPREADSHEET} row, and any value with no certificate line is left blank. The transportation engineer witnesses the material where the standard requires it, compares the row with the limits, and signs pass or fail in {DOCS}. A model does not invent a test value.
tasks.previous_blocker: Certificates were scanned packs, so the limit and the reported value were not in the same row.
tasks.enabler_now: A standard limit can be a named field, and a certificate line can be tied to that name.
tasks.still_hard: A borderline result, a substituted product, and what the engineer sees in the stockpile are still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer accepts the certificate and signs the environmental decision.
tasks.altitude: Retyping certificate values shrinks. Witnessing and the signature do not. The engineer can reject a row the certificate does not support.

reach.task: Replace a certificate the engineer marked unreadable
reach.learn: Which lots are signed pass or fail and which values were left blank

evidence.claim: Checking materials against an environmental standard is certificate reading plus a witness where the standard asks for one. The decision stays with the engineer.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. A value is filed only when it is on the certificate or the engineer's note, not when a model wrote it.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the signed environmental material decision. Strength and gradation tests are a separate task.

Input contract: material id, lot id, standard id, limit name, limit value, certificate value. Producer of the certificate is the materials supplier. Producer of the limit is the standard table. An unreadable certificate stays manual and is not passed.
Use the sheet's own lookup against the limit table before custom code. The document prior fits. The meeting prior does not: this is reading and a witness, not a hearing.
The design does not score suppliers as people and does not watch staff.
unknowns: Which standards are tables and which are prose.
Whether the witness must be the engineer or may be the technician.
research_questions: What share of certificates has no material id?
How often is a limit disputed after the value matched the table?

already_counted.description: Engineer corrects values the certificate read got wrong
Witness time stays with the engineer
The pass or fail stays in the signature

incremental.description: Add limit rows when a standard issue changes a threshold
Suppliers replace certificates that were left blank

approvals.approved_version: environmental material decision signed for this lot id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes certificates stay unscanned, so values are typed by hand and the witness is unchanged. The high case assumes clean rows, while every borderline lot and every signature stays with the engineer. Witness time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct surveying, staking and laying out

steps.what: Prepare staking points from the layout
Check control before staking on site
Direct the surveying and staking
Decide and sign the surveying change
File the signed surveying record

tasks.design: A stake list in {SPREADSHEET} is filled from the signed layout: point id, easting, northing, offset and level. The surveyor checks the control points. The transportation engineer directs surveying and staking on site and signs the as-staked record, including any field change. Only that signed record is filed on the {PROJECT} file. Coordinates are not invented for a point the layout does not contain.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordinates were read off a drawing on site, so the stake list and the as-staked note did not share point ids.
tasks.enabler_now: The signed layout can export point ids and coordinates as rows.
tasks.still_hard: A clash between the layout and the ground is still decided on site by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer directs the crew and signs any change to the layout.
tasks.altitude: Retyping coordinates shrinks. Standing on site does not. The engineer can refuse to stake a point with no coordinates.

reach.task: Stake only the points on the signed list
reach.learn: Which point ids are current and which field changes the engineer has signed

evidence.claim: Directing stake-out is mostly time on site. The list of coordinates is the part that can be prepared before anyone leaves the office.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. A coordinate is taken from the signed layout, not written by a model.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the filed as-staked record. The surveyor's instrument time is other-role time.
Input contract: layout id, point id, easting, northing, offset, level. Producer is the signed layout. A point with no coordinate is omitted and listed as manual.
Use the layout export and the project file's own register before custom code. The in-person prior is accepted. Office preparation is not a meeting.
unknowns: Which layouts have no coordinate export.
Who signs a field change if the engineer is not on site.
What control network the surveyor must use.
research_questions: What share of points has no coordinate on the signed layout?
How often does a field change revise a point after staking starts?

already_counted.description: Engineer fixes points the layout export missed
Site direction stays with the engineer
The field change and signature stay with the engineer

incremental.description: Update the stake-list columns when a layout type adds a new offset

approvals.approved_version: as-staked record signed for this layout id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes layouts stay as drawings without coordinates, so the list is still read by hand and the site day is unchanged. The high case assumes a clean point export, while directing the work and signing any change stay with the engineer. Surveyor time on the instrument is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design sustainable pavements and bioretention structures

steps.what: Send constraints for the sustainable design
Reconcile constraints for the pavement design

loop.output: gaps for a missing soil class, rainfall row or outfall
loop.check: Each gap names a site id and a missing field
loop.stop: One pass, then stop the draft for a site with no soil class
loop.why_not_simpler: Investigation prose does not match a rainfall row by a fixed map

steps.what: Draft the sustainable pavement layout

loop.input: constraint fields and the layout template
loop.output: layout whose dimensions each cite a field
loop.check: Every dimension equals a submitted field
loop.stop: Leave the dimension blank and stop that sheet if the field is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: How the layers sit on this site is not a mail-merge

steps.what: Check slopes and thicknesses on the design
Sign the bioretention or pavement choice
File the signed sustainable design

tasks.design: The site investigator submits soil class, area, rainfall row and outfall id on a {WORKFLOW} form. A draft layout in {DOCS} may use only those fields for dimensions. Coded checks then flag slope, thickness and setback against the rules on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. The transportation engineer chooses porous pavement or bioretention and signs one version. A failed check blocks filing. This task does not decide a road-safety device.
tasks.previous_blocker: Soil and rainfall lived in separate notes, so a draft could not show which constraint a thickness came from.
tasks.enabler_now: Constraint fields and geometric rules can share a site id, so a thickness can be checked against a submitted value.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the ground and the maintenance regime can support the option is still the engineer's call.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer chooses the material and signs the layout.

ambition.what: Add a checked porous-pavement or bioretention option on street schemes that previously had only a conventional section

tasks.altitude: Redrafting dimensions shrinks. The material choice does not. The engineer can refuse a layout that fails a coded check or cites a thickness with no field.

reach.task: Supply the soil class the draft left blank
reach.learn: Which sites are signed and which rules the layout failed

evidence.claim: A sustainable layout in a mid-size firm is a drawing plus a short calculation. The choice of material is the part that stays a signature.

Digest [S5] describes coded rule checks on a building model, such as clashes and required clearances. The same pattern can flag slope, thickness and setback on a layout. It does not choose the material.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. Dimensions in the draft must match the constraint form, not a model-written figure.

Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. Porous pavement and bioretention here are drainage choices, not a safety-component decision, and the engineer still signs.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the filed layout. Drainage calculations that are a separate commissioned study stay out of scope.

Input contract: site id, soil class, area, rainfall row id, outfall id, proposed layer thickness. Producer is the site investigator. If soil class is missing, the draft stops for that site and the engineer marks it manual.
Use the document template and the rule report the model store can already run before custom code. The meeting prior overstates this task. The work is a layout and a short sign-off.
No road-traffic safety device is selected here. If a later scheme adds one, that decision is a different task and is not taken by the draft.
unknowns: Whether maintenance of bioretention is funded.
Who signs when the engineer is the reviewer of their own layout.
research_questions: What share of sites has no soil class?
How often does a coded check fail on thickness after the draft?

already_counted.description: Engineer resolves missing constraints before the draft is used
Engineer edits the layout where the template is weak
The material choice stays in the signature

incremental.description: Update rule thresholds when a thickness standard changes
Site investigators refill a form the draft stopped

approvals.approved_version: sustainable design signed for this site id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes soil and rainfall stay as prose, so the draft rarely starts and the engineer still draws by hand. The high case assumes complete constraint fields, while the material choice and the signature stay with the engineer. A passing rule check is not treated as a signed design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test materials against the project specification

steps.what: Load the specifications for these materials
Record readings for the materials test
Witness the materials test on site
Mark readings outside the specifications
Decide materials compliance for the lot
File the signed materials result

tasks.design: Specification limits for the lot load into a {SPREADSHEET} from the signed spec. The testing technician records raw readings. The transportation engineer witnesses the materials test, and the sheet marks only readings that miss a limit. The engineer decides accept, retest or reject, and only that signed result is filed on the {PROJECT} lot. A model does not write a reading.
tasks.previous_blocker: Limits sat in the specification volume and readings sat on a paper sheet, so a pass was judged without a shared lot id.
tasks.enabler_now: Property name, limit and reading can share a lot id and a sample id.
tasks.still_hard: A failed sample can be a bad test or a bad material, and that call stays with the engineer who watched it.
tasks.human_edge: The transportation engineer witnesses the test and decides accept, retest or reject.

ambition.what: Record a pass, fail or retest on every lot, not only on lots the engineer happened to witness

tasks.altitude: Looking up limits shrinks. Witnessing does not. The engineer can block a lot result that has no sample id or no signature.

reach.task: Retest only the lots the engineer marked retest
reach.learn: Which sample ids failed which limit, and which results are signed

evidence.claim: Specification testing is a witnessed test plus a comparison with a limit. The witness is the bulk of the time and stays in person.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data. Readings are copied from the test sheet. A model must not file a number the technician did not record.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at the filed lot result. Environmental certificates are a separate task.

Input contract: lot id, spec id, property, limit, sample id, reading. Producer of the limit is the signed specification. Producer of the reading is the testing technician. A sheet with no sample id is not compared.
Use the specification table and the project lot register before custom code. The in-person prior is accepted for the witness. The comparison itself is a sheet, not a meeting.
unknowns: Which tests the engineer must witness in person.
Who may reject a lot when the engineer is off site.
Whether the technician is in-house or a hired laboratory.
research_questions: What share of test sheets has no sample id?
How often is the first result sent for a retest?

already_counted.description: Witness time on the test stays with the engineer
Accept, retest or reject stays in the signature

incremental.description: Add properties when a specification issue changes a limit
Technicians correct sheets that have no sample id

approvals.approved_version: lot result signed for this sample id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes readings stay on paper without a sample id, so the comparison rarely runs and the witness is unchanged. The high case assumes clean sheets, while witnessing and the accept or reject decision stay with the engineer. Technician time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Stake lists, limit checks and sustainable drafts take less rewriting, while site direction, witnessing and the material choice stay with the transportation engineer.
reach: Surveyors take the stake list to site instead of retyping coordinates from a drawing.
Testing technicians learn which lots are accepted, which need a retest, and which limit was used.
skills_to_grow: State a material limit as a number a sheet can compare.
Direct staking from a coordinate list and record any field change before signing.
Keep a sustainable layout's dimensions equal to the constraint form.
role.ambitious_version: Every lot has a signed pass, fail or retest, every site opens from a stake list, and a sustainable option is rule-checked before the engineer signs.
